objectives: Create and Manage KV Store Collections

tasks.instruction: In KV Store, select sh01 and app kv_training. Create service_owners with field.service=string, field.owner=string and enforceTypes=true. Add checkout→Platform and auth→Identity records with stable keys checkout and auth.

Configure a KV lookup transform service_owners: external_type=kvstore, collection=service_owners, fields_list=service,owner. Activate the app configuration with the supported teaching reload. Search index=source_logs | lookup service_owners service OUTPUT owner | stats count by owner. Verify Platform=2 and Identity=1 from actual data.
